content: coffee A controlled explosion on a film set near London’s O2 arena ignited a fire that consumed a van and heavily damaged a car and a lorry. Firefighters were dispatched to an open‑air yard on Dock Road in Silvertown just before 8 p.m. on Saturday, and after about an hour the blaze was contained with the help of twenty‑five crew members, with no injuries reported. The incident is believed to have stemmed from a pre‑planned filming activity at the site, which is close to the venue that will host performances by Niall Horan and Texas later in the week. The London Fire Brigade posted on X that the fire in the Silvertown yard is now under control, noting that one vehicle was destroyed while most of a car and a lorry suffered damage, and that there are no injury reports. They added that the fire originated from the controlled explosion that spread beyond expectations, that crews worked swiftly to put it out, and that personnel will stay on scene for the rest of the evening. The yard is also situated near the Thames cable‑car link, and a Metropolitan Police spokesman said they are aware of reports of explosions heard in the area around the O2 in Greenwich.
